queries.sql: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE lower(customer_email) = lower('emma.song905@example.com') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE lower(email) = lower('emma.song905@example.com') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT o.order_id AS o__order_id, o.payment_id AS o__payment_id, o.email AS o__email, o.reward_key AS o__reward_key, o.amount AS o__amount, o.status AS o__status, o.credited AS o__credited, o.created_at AS o__created_at, o.updated_at AS o__updated_at, p.payment_id AS p__payment_id, p.amount AS p__amount, p.currency AS p__currency, p.status AS p__status, p.card_last4 AS p__card_last4, p.customer_email AS p__customer_email, p.created_at AS p__created_at, g.grant_id AS g__grant_id, g.email AS g__email, g.reward_key AS g__reward_key, g.credits AS g__credits, g.status AS g__status, g.order_id AS g__order_id, g.created_at AS g__created_at, l.ts AS l__ts, l.route AS l__route, l.order_id AS l__order_id, l.http_status AS l__http_status, l.message AS l__message, m.email_id AS m__email_id, m.to_address AS m__to_address, m.event AS m__event, m.ts AS m__ts, m.order_tag AS m__order_tag FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = o.payment_id LEFT JOIN grants g ON g.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN server_logs l ON l.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN mail_events m ON m.order_tag = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id = 'ord_0905'

claims.sentence: 注文 ord_0905 の orders テーブルでは payment_id が null、credited が 0、status が pending であることから、決済プロバイダーでの請求は行われていません【orders:ord_0905】。また、サーバーログには /api/checkout/start しか記録されておらず、決済ステップに到達していないことが確認できます【server_logs:2026-10-20T05:00:00Z@/api/checkout/start】。
